intro: Madrid is the Republic’s political heart, and the Army of Africa has reached its outskirts after months of rebel advance. Militia columns, newly organised units of the Ejército Popular, and the first foreign volunteers must hold the capital street by street while the government struggles to create a real army from the chaos of July. The bridges, western approaches, and urban strongpoints cannot all be defended equally, so reserves must be committed with care. Stop the assault, preserve the capital, and prove that Franco’s drive can be broken before fascist victory begins to look inevitable.

briliant.text:
El ejercito de Africa ha sido frenado en seco!, es el primer exito importante de nuestras valerosas tropas. Gran trabajo, general. Madrid ha sido defendido con exito y ahora se convertira en el ejemplo a seguir por todos los pueblos de este pais, que estan tratando de resistir a la amenaza fascista.

The African Army has been stopped! This is the first important successful action of our soldiers. Great work, Madrid has been successfully defended, and now it will be a resistance symbol for the people of this country fighting against the Fascist menace!

intro: The direct assault on Madrid has failed, so the rebel command now tries to encircle the capital from the south-east through the Jarama valley. If the crossings and high ground fall, the road linking Madrid with Valencia may be cut and the city slowly strangled. Republican formations and International Brigade battalions must absorb a powerful attack, counter local breakthroughs, and prevent the enemy from joining hands across the river. Hold the valley, protect the communications of the capital, and turn Jarama into proof that the People’s Army can survive a battle of attrition.

Congratulations! You have showed the proper skills to be a good commander for the People's Army. The Rebel offensive has been stopped for the moment, and the fascists have already seen the valor of our troops.

intro: Italian troops of the Corpo Truppe Volontarie are massing along the Brihuega–Torija line, confident that motorised columns and air power will finish what the rebels failed to achieve at Madrid. Soviet advisers and Republican reconnaissance have identified the concentration, giving you a rare chance to meet the offensive before it gathers full momentum. Use the weather, terrain, armour, and mobile reserves to isolate the Italian spearheads and strike their exposed flanks. A decisive victory at Guadalajara can end the immediate threat to Madrid and transform a defensive war into the Republic’s first great triumph.

briliant.text:
Magnifico!, los italianos huyen despaboridos mientras los rebeldes tratan de mantener las lineas de frente. Esta derrota despeja por completo el peligro sobre Madrid, al menos por el momento, y nos posibilitara empezar a pensar en acciones ofensivas en semanas posteriores.

Great! The Italians are running to the hills instead of trying to hold their front lines. This victory will stop the rebel menace at Madrid, at least for the moment, and allow us to think about further operations in the coming weeks.

intro: With Madrid secure and new Soviet equipment reaching the front, the Republic is ready to attempt its first major offensive. The plan at Brunete is ambitious: break through from the north and east, threaten the rebel forces west of Madrid, and force Franco to divert strength from the Northern Front. Success depends on speed before enemy air superiority and experienced reserves can stabilise the line. Punch through the initial positions, exploit with armour, and seize the key towns while your supply routes remain open. Even a costly advance may relieve pressure elsewhere—but only a clean breakthrough can change the strategic balance.

Buen trabajo.

All the goals have been achieved. However, due to the enemy air superiority and the quality of their troops, we must retreat our troops from Brunete to Northern positions.

intro: The fall of the Northern Front draws closer, and the Republic must force the enemy to look away from Asturias and Cantabria. A new offensive in Aragón aims toward Zaragoza, but the open ground, dispersed Republican formations, and rapid rebel counterattacks make the operation dangerously fragile. Advance through weak sectors, secure Belchite and the surrounding communications, and prevent local successes from being isolated. The campaign will reward commanders who keep their forces concentrated and recognise when the main objective is slipping away. A secondary victory may still buy time, morale, and political value for the Republic.

briliant.text:
El plan principal ha fracasado... el contraataque enemigo frustro nuestro ataque sobre Zaragoza, sin embargo los servicios de propaganda explotaran esta victoria secundaria en Belchite de la mejor manera posible.

The main plan hasn't been accomplished, the rebel counterattack defeated our attack on Zaragoza. However, our propaganda services will try to exploit this minor victory at Belchite...

However, commandante, you must understand that tactical victories do not balance strategic failures.

intro: The Northern Front has collapsed and the rebel armies are preparing to drive toward the Mediterranean, threatening Valencia and the territory that still links the Republic together. To seize the initiative in winter, the People’s Army will attack the exposed city of Teruel before the enemy can complete its plans. The battle will be fought through freezing weather, mountain roads, and fortified urban ground, followed inevitably by a powerful counterstroke. Capture the city, hold it against relief forces, and avoid exhausting your best formations before the enemy offensive has truly begun.

The rebel offensive in and around Levante has been stopped after our victory in Teruel!. Excellent work!

intro: The rebels have reached the Mediterranean and split Republican territory in two. The Ebro offensive is the Republic’s boldest—and perhaps last—attempt to reverse the war. Under cover of darkness, the People’s Army must cross the river near Amposta and elsewhere, rupture a sector the enemy considers secure, and drive toward Gandesa before reserves and air power arrive. Engineers, bridges, artillery, and disciplined exploitation will decide whether the surprise crossing becomes a strategic breakthrough or a trapped bridgehead. Cross fast, widen the corridor, and force Franco to abandon the Levant.

briliant.text:
Fantastico!, los rebeldes se baten en retirada, nuestro ataque por sorpresa cruzando el Ebro ha sido todo un exito gracias a su pericia. Ahora todo el sector de Levante que los fascistas habian alcanzado esta comprometido y deberan retirarse de ahi si no quieren verse rodeados. Esta victoria elevara la moral de toda la zona leal al gobierno.

Wonderful! The rebels are in disarray and retreating all their units in the sector. Our surprise attack across the Ebro has been totally accomplished thanks to your skills, and brave soldiers. Now, all of the Levante sector under rebel control is in chaos and will soon be recaptured by El Ejercito Popular. This victory will increase the morale of all the citizens of free Spain!

Congratulations, General.

victory.text:
Hemos conseguido alcanzar una victoria estrategica, pero el enemigo ha sabido encajar el golpe y la ofensiva no va a tener los efectos planeados... ahora se espera un fuerte contraataque enemigo. Prepare las trincheras.

We have achieved a minor victory, however the enemy has stopped our advance and in several other sectors. The planned offensive won't reach all the main goals, and many enemy formations are still operational. Intelligence has warned of a counterattack in your sector soon. I advise you to order your troops to dig in.

Commandante, you must hold your lines if the Republic is to survive.

intro: The advance beyond the Ebro has stalled before Gandesa, while German and Italian aircraft pound the bridgeheads and rebel reinforcements close from every direction. The great offensive has failed to achieve its strategic aim; the immediate task is now to save the army that carried it out. Conduct an organised withdrawal across the river, protect the remaining bridges, evacuate artillery and experienced units, and use rearguards to prevent pursuit from becoming a massacre. This is a battle of discipline under pressure: every formation brought back intact may be essential to the Republic’s final defence.

briliant.text:

What!?? Where are you going with those troops!!?? What kind of retreat are you making??? Your cowardice shows you are not the general which the People's Army needs! You are dismissed, as an officer, but not from the army, private!

tactical.text:

Fortunately, you have managed to make a careful retreat to the other bank of the river, and most of the People's Army is now safe for the moment. Unfortunately, careful retreats and saving what is left of our army will not defeat the Falangists.

Nationalist officer - "Aha!, a Republican General! The high command of the Generalisimo will be pleased to know that your nasty ''Army of the Ebro'' has been destroyed, and also that we have captured a red general! [evil laughter]. You will be executed soon for your betrayal of Spain!

"Despite you, Spain shall be 'un grande libre.'"

intro: After the disaster on the Ebro, Franco’s armies are pressing into Catalonia and the Republic’s position is collapsing. The command hopes to slow the offensive around Lérida by correcting the front and recovering two important power stations beyond the Segre. Your force must cross or fight along the river, seize the industrial objectives, and then survive the enemy’s inevitable response. The victory will not reverse the war, but it can buy time for civilians, units, and political cadres to escape the encirclement. Fight for every day the Republic still possesses.

Personalmente le sugiero que hagamos lo mismo y nos salvemos antes de que sea tarde, la ofensiva rebelde sobre Catalunya continua imparable...

Nota historica--- Historicamente la guerra termino en Abril de 1939, despues de la caida de Catalunya y la redicion de Madrid a las tropas rebeldes.

This victory will allow us to take a breath, but I must warn you that many army officers have joined the enemy! Others have abandoned the fight and crossed the Spanish - French border to escape. Personally, I advise you to cross the border, too, and save yourself. I think the rebel offensive is unbeatable now.

Historical note--- The war finally ended in April, 1939 with the rebel victory after the fall of Catalunya and the surrender of Madrid to rebels. The prelude to WWII was over, and September 1, 1939 was quickly approaching.

A clear victory will reopen the road into Aragón and place Zaragoza within reach. Maintain pressure, prevent the enemy from rebuilding, and make this river battle the bridge from survival to final offensive.

intro: The successful counteroffensive has forced the rebels back from the Mediterranean, while the reopening of the French frontier allows long-awaited Soviet weapons to reach the Republic. Zaragoza now stands as the next great prize and the gateway toward Burgos. The city is protected by experienced troops, foreign support, and prepared approaches, but the strategic balance has shifted in your favour. Coordinate armour, infantry, artillery, and air support, isolate the garrison, and break the defensive ring without allowing the offensive to lose momentum. Take Zaragoza and carry the People’s Army into the enemy heartland.

intro: The rebellion has collapsed across the Peninsula. Burgos has fallen, northern uprisings have shattered the enemy rear, and many rebel units have abandoned Franco’s cause. The surviving insurgent forces have withdrawn across the Strait to the Spanish protectorate in Morocco, where the war began. The final campaign leads to Ceuta: secure the coast, defeat the remaining formations, and prevent their escape or foreign reinforcement. This is the last operation of the civil war and the first test of the peace that follows. Finish the struggle, reunite Spain under the Republic, and close the road that carried the Army of Africa to the mainland.

briliant.text:
LA GUERRA HA TERMINADO!, en multitud de puntos del pais se celebra la victoria por todo lo alto!. De ahora en adelante se abre una nueva etapa en la que nuestra patria debe modernizarse y afrontar nuevos desafios. Usted formara parte en adelante de la historia de Espana para siempre.

The WAR IS OVER! All the people are in the streets celebrating the victory of the Republic's victory over the fascist rebels! From now, and in the future, a new political system will try to modernize Spain without any kind of capitalist or traditionalist intervention. Excellent work general, obviously you are one of the new heroes of the Spanish Republic, and your name will be written for ever in the ancient Spanish history.

From now, and in the future, a new political system will try to modernize Spain without any kind of capitalist or traditionalist intervention. Excellent work general, obviously you are one of the new heroes of the Spanish Republic, and your name will be written for ever in the ancient Spanish history.

Oficial Nacionalista- AH!, que tenemos aqui?, un general republicano!. El alto mando del Generalisimo estara encantado de saber que hemos capturado a un general rojo, esto es un paso mas para librar a este pais de canallas como usted!. Jajaja!, quiere usted unirse al bando que va a vencer?, no?, entonces se pudrira usted en la carcel!.

Nationalist officer - "AH!, buenos dias ''general''! The High Headquarters of Generalisimo Franco will be happy knowing that we have made another step to free this country by capturing one of the most popular Republican generals!
